en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, altogether from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Sa’dan, from someone else, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘As for the people of Al-Kufa, had they welcomed their children (newborns) with the water of the Euphrates, they would have been our<sup>asws</sup> Shiah’.
en.sarwar: 5. Al-Husayn from Muhammad and Muhammad ibn Yahya all from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sa‘dan from more than one person in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If people of al-Kufah drop water of Euphrates in the mouth of their new born, they would become of our followers.’”
